scope: Prove the three persistent Love Day wave barrels have no surviving gameplay admission path after Love Day producer retirement while preserving the shared wave controller and passive serialized anchors.

eraEvidence.core3Boundary: No Love Day, Ewok Festival of Love, holiday barrel, or matching wave-event quest exists in the pinned Publish 14.1 Core3 tree.
eraEvidence.questBoundary: Only three Mr. Hate quest-task tables target the holiday barrel; the legacy table has no grant producer and both grantable v2 variants are issued exclusively by Blaire.
eraEvidence.controllerBoundary: The generic wave controller requires both the player-side wave task script and an active task whose SERVER_TEMPLATE exactly matches the interacted object.

runtimeEvidence.reason: This milestone changes no runtime source or data. It proves that the already-retired sole quest giver cannot admit players to the retained passive controller.
